topic: Adjusting frequency calculation for India cluster
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on verifying and adjusting the deployment of a frequency metric, specifically for India. Initially, [p1] requested to view the frequency data on the ML API stage. It was clarified that the goal was not viewing general frequency but checking how the deployed frequency calculation works on the ML API stage.

[p1] later identified an issue with calculating traffic metrics over January because half of the sensors only started working on the 15th. To correct this, [p1] implemented a change in their aggregation script for India by modifying the logic to count sessions where `screen_number > 1`.

[me] confirmed that they would make the necessary changes to the aggregation script rather than having [p1] do it themselves.
decisions: The frequency calculation deployment status on the ML API stage needs verification for India.
[me] will modify the aggregation script for India.
action_items: A ticket needs to be created (or updated) to track the changes made to the frequency calculation and aggregation scripts.
